_readme: S740, lane 2's cheap piles (2026-11-26). Two Santa Barbara City records hold on what their own pages print (s739d). 43553 (Law, Public Policy, and Society A.A.-T): its two lists print 26-29 and 6-8, which add to 32-37 under a printed total of 35-41, and no note of the record names the difference; total_differs is filed only from a page read (kb/program_total_differs.json). 30746 (Sociology A.A.-T): the state's list names PSY 200, which the record does not place and no note explains, so coverage fails. This read prints each page as the capture reads it, so a session can read 43553's list figures and total line word for word, and whether 30746's page prints PSY 200 anywhere in its lists. Two loads, no model call, nothing written.

questions.figures_43553: The Required Core figure, the List A figure and the total line of the Law, Public Policy, and Society AA-T, word for word, and any line between them that carries units.
questions.psy_200: Whether the Sociology AA-T page prints PSY 200 in any list, and under which list heading.
